songs.title: Tzama lecha nafsi
songs.lyrics:
צָמְאָה לְךָ  נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם
כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ

tzamah l'cha nafshi kamah l'kha v'sari
b'eretz tziyah v'ayef b'li mayim
(ken bakodesh chazitikha lirot uz'cha uch'vodekha)(3x)

God, You are my God; I search for You, my soul thirsts for You, my body yearns for You, as a parched and thirsty land that has no water.
I shall behold You in the sanctuary, and see Your might and glory.
